Historical graph is not independent groundtruth
Synthetic warm proxy does not establish real skin fidelity or artistic grading
Saturated BT2020 primaries exceed709gamut; codeclipping is measured, no inference that all clipping is avoidable

This isolates the tone-map filter math. Production appends HDR mastering/content-light side-data deletion; this harness does not, and PQ1000/PQ4000 H264 outputs retain Content light level SEI. These files are not independently qualified SDR grade references.
